State info (starting/failed) appears as a small tag on the right of the row only when state ≠ ready, plus a glance footer with progress / error + retry. Ready rows look identical to current.
round1_changes: Removed all runtimeKind icon prefixes (⌂ ▣ ◆ ↗ ↳) from Drawer rows per user feedback ('煩雑な印象')

design_decisions.decision: Runtime kind is shown as plain text only — NO icon anywhere (modals, header chip, context menu)
design_decisions.rationale: User feedback round 2: '何か一般的に使われているアイコンなのでしょうか? これを見てシステムコンテナだとかVMだとか一目でみんなわかる?'. The glyphs (⌂ ▣ ◆ ↗ ↳) were ad-hoc — Docker/LXD/VirtualBox/Hyper-V each use different raster icons; no single Unicode character is universally understood. Without a legend the icons are noise. Text labels (lxd-container / lxd-vm / lxd-remote / ssh-remote / host) are unambiguous on their own and read identically on any monitor / locale.

design_decisions.decision: Drawer rows are unchanged from current production design — no per-row runtime indicator
design_decisions.rationale: User feedback round 1: 'Drawerのruntimeのグリフは煩雑な印象がある'. With 4+ Workspaces visible, an extra column added visual noise without helping the common case. Runtime kind is shown in the header chip for the active Workspace and via right-click for others.

design_decisions.decision: Header chip carries runtime kind + state for the active Workspace (text-only)
design_decisions.rationale: Always-visible at the top, no extra clicks. 'lxd-container · ready' is more legible than any single-character glyph could be. The state dot (●) is kept since it's a universal status convention (green=OK, etc.) — and color alone is enough information once the label is text.

design_decisions.decision: Non-ready Drawer rows get a 'starting' / 'failed' tag on the right side; ready rows show nothing
design_decisions.rationale: Keeps Drawer minimal in the steady state. Only deviation from current design appears for transient states the user MUST know about (cloud-init in progress, image pull failed). Spinner + red dot leverage existing styles.css patterns.

design_decisions.decision: Open Repository / Workspace creation modals do NOT have a 'Don't ask again' checkbox
design_decisions.rationale: User feedback round 1: '毎回選ぶでOK'. Always asking for runtime per Repository Open is the simpler mental model — no hidden default-setting side effect. AC-Sdd4ce1-5-3 should be removed during sprint plan for Sdd4ce1 (TODO: ROADMAP edit deferred to sprint auto).

design_decisions.decision: Switching runtime with active Bash/Claude tabs shows a confirmation dialog
design_decisions.rationale: User feedback round 1 Q3 = A. Aligns with DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority_rule 7 (明示的 > 暗黙的). Implicit kill of streaming Claude / long-running Bash would be a UX violation. Dialog lists each affected tab with its state, danger button to confirm.

design_decisions.decision: Mobile (<600px) 'Change runtime…' submenu opens as a full-screen sheet
design_decisions.rationale: User feedback round 1 Q4 = A. Aligns with VISION priority 10 (mobile parity). Drawer is already modalized on mobile, so a full-screen sheet for the submenu matches the existing mobile pattern.

design_decisions.decision: Runtime change context-menu uses a submenu (not a modal-on-modal)
design_decisions.rationale: Per spec §9.3. Matches existing 'right-click → action' pattern in S030 repo overflow menu. Inline submenu avoids modal-on-modal.

design_decisions.decision: host runtime is shown last in the radio list with '⚠ NO ISOLATION' badge
design_decisions.rationale: Default for new repos is lxd-container (per VISION/PRINCIPLES — clean host). host stays available for migration / debugging but its position+badge nudges users toward isolation. The ⚠ symbol IS standard for warnings, so it's kept.

round1_user_feedback.Q2_icon_customization: Drawer icons removed entirely; question moot
round1_user_feedback.Q3_change_runtime_confirm: A (確認ダイアログを出す)
round1_user_feedback.extra: Open Repository モーダルの 'Don't ask again' チェックボックス不要 — 毎回選ばせる

round2_user_feedback.feedback: 各ランタイムのアイコンは一般的なものでもなく、 これを見てシステムコンテナだとか VM だとか一目でわからないなら不要
round2_user_feedback.applied: All ad-hoc Unicode glyphs (⌂ ▣ ◆ ↗ ↳) removed from modals, header chip, and context menu. Text-only labels everywhere. State dot (●) kept on header chip since color-coded dots are a universal status convention.
